sources: TDS on bank FD interest: ₹50,000/saal (senior ₹1 lakh) se upar, 10% (PAN ke saath), bina PAN 20%; limit per bank (Finance Act 2025, FY 2026-27 mein bhi same; TaxGarden, Arthzo, Peak BCS). ₹8 lakh × 7% = sirf example. TDS ≠ final tax.

scenes.voice: FD का|ka ब्याज|byaaj पूरा|poora नहीं|nahi मिला?|mila? Bank ने|ne TDS काटा_है!|kaata_hai!

scenes.label: Ek bank se saal ka byaaj isse upar = TDS
scenes.voice: एक_बैंक_से|Ek_bank_se साल_का|saal_ka ब्याज|byaaj पचास_हज़ार|₹50,000 से_ऊपर,|se_upar, senior के_लिए|ke_liye एक_लाख,|₹1_lakh, तो|toh दस_परसेंट|10% TDS. PAN नहीं|nahi तो|toh बीस।|20.

scenes.title: ₹8 lakh FD, 7% byaaj
scenes.voice: आठ_लाख|₹8_lakh की|ki FD, सात_परसेंट:|7%: ब्याज|byaaj छप्पन_हज़ार,|₹56,000, तो|toh छप्पन_सौ|₹5,600 TDS कटा।|kata.

scenes.title: Kya karein? ✅
scenes.voice: PAN ज़रूर|zaroor दो,|do, income कम_है|kam_hai तो|toh bank को|ko declaration form दो,|do, और|aur ज़्यादा|zyada कटा|kata तो|toh ITR भरके|bharke refund लो।|lo.

scenes.disclaimer: Educational only. TDS final tax nahi, CA se confirm karein.
scenes.voice: आपका|Aapka TDS कटा?|kata? हाँ_एक,|Haan_1, ना_दो।|na_2. Finance_Junction follow_करो!|follow_karo!
